devdoc.details: Deployed as a transparent proxy. Admin identity is read from      `SmartWalletCoordinator.owner()` at call time; there is no local owner storage.      `lockDuration` applies only to future deposits; existing positions are unaffected by      any subsequent `setLockDuration` call.

SafeERC20FailedOperation(address).details: An operation with an ERC-20 token failed.

Initialized(uint8).details: Triggered when the contract has been initialized or reinitialized.

Paused(address).details: Emitted when the pause is triggered by `account`.

params.positionId: Unique identifier of the new position.
params.unlockAt: Earliest timestamp at which the position may be withdrawn.

params.recipient: Address that received the withdrawn tokens.
params.token: ERC-20 token withdrawn from this contract.

params.fromStaking: Tokens sourced from direct staking positions.
params.recipient: Address that received the tokens (currently always `user`).

Unpaused(address).details: Emitted when the pause is lifted by `account`.

constructor.details: Disables initializers on the implementation contract so it cannot be initialized      directly. Initialization must happen atomically through the proxy's constructor.

deposit(uint256).details: Pulls `amount` of the staking token from the caller via `transferFrom`. The caller      must approve this contract before calling. A unique position ID is derived from a      monotonic nonce. `lockDuration` at deposit time determines `unlockAt`.

params.amount: Token amount to stake in wei.

returns.details: Summary, all vesting positions (max 4), all staking positions.

getUserStakeDetailsPage(address,uint256,.details: The `summary` and `stakingPositionCount` always reflect the full account.      Vesting positions are always returned in full (max 4); only staking positions are windowed.

params.positionLimit: Maximum number of staking positions to return.
params.positionOffset: Zero-based index of the first staking position to include.

getUserStakeSummary(address).details: `totalVipStake = vestingUnclaimed + stakingLocked + stakingWithdrawable`.      Tokens already withdrawn are excluded from VIP calculations.

initialize(address,uint64).details: The vesting contract is not stored here — it is resolved at call time from      `coordinator.vestingContract()`.

params.lockDuration_: Initial lock period for new staking deposits.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

params.amount: Token amount to stake in wei.

returns._0: The ERC-20 token address read from `coordinator.stakingToken()`.

unlock(uint256).details: Priority order: (1) claimable vesting, (2) unlocked direct staking.      Locked vesting and locked direct staking are never touched.      Vesting tokens are transferred here first; staking tokens are already held here.      A single outbound transfer is made to the caller after all state is updated (CEI).      Reverts if nothing can be unlocked (no claimable vesting and no withdrawable staking).

params.amount: Maximum tokens to withdraw in wei.
Token amount to withdraw in wei.

withdrawToken(address,address,uint256).details: Intentionally permits withdrawing tokens backing direct staking positions. This is a      break-glass action and can leave staking withdrawals underfunded.

params.amount: Token amount to withdraw in wei.
params.recipient: Address that receives the withdrawn tokens.

_positions.details: Staking positions keyed by position ID.

_userPositionIds.details: Ordered list of position IDs for each depositor.

devdoc.title: Staking

NotCoordinatorOwner().notice: Thrown when a caller other than `coordinator.owner()` invokes an admin function.

NothingUnlockable().notice: Thrown when `unlock` finds no claimable vesting or withdrawable staking for the caller.

ZeroAddress().notice: Thrown when an address argument is zero.

ZeroAmount().notice: Thrown when a zero amount is passed to `deposit` or `unlock`.

StakingLockDurationUpdated(uint64,uint64.notice: Emitted when the lock duration for future deposits changes.

StakingPositionCreated(bytes32,address,u.notice: Emitted when a new staking position is created via `deposit`.

StakingPositionWithdrawn(bytes32,address.notice: Emitted once per position whenever tokens are withdrawn from it.

TokenWithdrawn(address,address,uint256).notice: Emitted when the coordinator owner performs an emergency token withdrawal.

TokensUnlocked(address,address,uint256,u.notice: Emitted at the end of every `unlock` call.

coordinator().notice: The coordinator contract from which admin identity, the staking token and         the vesting contract are read.

deposit(uint256).notice: Opens a new time-locked staking position.

getUserStakeDetails(address).notice: Returns the full account details in a single call.

getUserStakeDetailsPage(address,uint256,.notice: Returns a paginated window of account details.

getUserStakeSummary(address).notice: Returns the aggregated staking and vesting summary for VIP and UI purposes.

initialize(address,uint64).notice: Initialises the contract for proxy deployment.

lockDuration().notice: Seconds added to `block.timestamp` to compute `unlockAt` for new deposits.

nextPositionId().notice: Monotonic counter used as the nonce when deriving position IDs.

setLockDuration(uint64).notice: Updates the lock duration applied to future deposits.

stake(uint256).notice: Alias for `deposit` — satisfies the `IStaking` interface consumed by SmartWallet.

token().notice: Returns the platform token used for deposits and withdrawals.

totalStakedBalanceOf(address).notice: Returns the combined staked balance used for protocol-level accounting.

unlock(uint256).notice: Withdraws up to `amount` tokens to the caller, claiming vesting first.

unpause().notice: Resumes deposits and unlocks after a pause.

unstake(uint256).notice: Alias for `unlock` — satisfies the `IStaking` interface consumed by SmartWallet.

vesting().notice: Returns the vesting contract used for claims and combined balance reads.

withdrawToken(address,address,uint256).notice: Emergency admin withdrawal for any ERC-20 held by this contract.

userdoc.notice: Holds direct staking deposits and acts as the single gateway for withdrawals,         vesting claims, and combined account reads. Users never interact with         `VestingDistributor` directly — all claim paths flow through this contract.
